inputs.task: UC1 Blender blocking: emit, then verify, the shot-spec JSON and the narrow-grammar bpy script described by the previous-pass design. Emit BEGIN_SHOT_SPEC_JSON/END_SHOT_SPEC_JSON containing the exact spec (schema_version "uc1.blender-blocking.v1", api_target "Blender 5.2 Python API", fps 24, resolution {width:1920,height:1080,percentage:100}, one scene string, exactly three cube subjects courier/crate/drone with the stated dims and initial locations, exactly three shots S01_APPROACH 1-96/4.0s, S02_REVEAL 97-168/3.0s, S03_RETREAT 169-240/3.0s with the stated camera loc/target/lens/framing and the sole allowed motions, no crate motion), then BEGIN_BLENDER_SCRIPT/END_BLENDER_SCRIPT with the narrow-grammar bpy script (unaliased imports bpy, math, then from mathutils import Vector in that exact order; functions look_at(obj,target), key_transform(obj,data_path,frame,value), build_scene(); scene alias from bpy.context.scene; object aliases from bpy.context.object stored in a {} dict; camera result bound to local name camera before camera.data; aim via Vector(target)-obj.location -> to_track_quat('-Z','Y') -> to_euler(); only the listed operators and allowed attributes; SHOT_SPEC embedded as the exact returned JSON literal; final module-level expression exactly build_scene()), plus BEGIN_CONTINUATION_LOG. Then run the host structural checker, the supplied standalone AST/API checker, and the scripted fallible review against the emitted artifacts, and record {pass,decision,reason,failed_checks,planned_changes} per verify with the actual verification reference. Iterate on any hard-check failure or high-severity review issue. No Blender execution is claimed; no file/network/process access. If the owner names a Blender plugin before launch, reseal around that documented plugin interface instead of plain bpy; do not invent one.
